note: Slots the merged manifest lacks, found by the README pass of 2026-10-02, plus four overlap questions. Requirements were written before any candidate was judged. Seeds are starting points for discovery, not preferences; their order carries no meaning.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.

slots.title: Local generation model
slots.requirement: Provide one open-weight text generation model that runs on the host's single 24 GB GPU beside an embedding model, as the local fallback for agent services when the hosted model route is unavailable, with reliable structured output and tool calling through an OpenAI-compatible local server.
slots.a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: On the RTX 4090 through one local server: structured-output validity and tool-call success on a fixed task set, answer quality on a public benchmark subset, tokens per second and peak GPU memory with the embedding model loaded.

slots.title: Local embedding model
slots.requirement: Provide one open-weight embedding model for retrieval over code, documents and agent session text, served locally on the host's GPU or CPU through an OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint.
slots.a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Retrieval quality on public text and code retrieval benchmarks at the same dimension budget, throughput and memory on the host, and maximum input length.

slots.title: Local reranker model
slots.requirement: Provide one open-weight reranking model, or establish that none is needed, for the second stage of local retrieval over code, documents and session text.
slots.a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Gain in top-5 retrieval quality over the first stage alone on a fixed query set, added latency per query and GPU memory beside the other local models.

slots.title: Alert routing and notification
slots.requirement: Route alerts from the local metrics and logs to the workstation's user, with grouping and silencing, without a paid service.
slots.a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Delivery of a fixed set of firing and resolved alerts to the user's devices, duplicate suppression, and behaviour across a restart.

slots.title: Coding agents in continuous integration
slots.requirement: Run the workstation's two coding agents from GitHub Actions on pull requests and issues with least privilege, or establish that neither action is needed.
slots.a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: On a fixed set of pull requests: review findings confirmed by a human, permissions requested, and cost per run.

slots.title: Agent session analytics
slots.requirement: Let the user inspect agent sessions across both coding agents (what ran, tool calls, tokens and cost per session) from local data, without a hosted service.
slots.a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Coverage of both agents' local session formats, agreement of token totals with the clients' own counters, and time to answer a fixed set of questions about past sessions.

slots.title: GPU access for containers
slots.requirement: Give rootless containers on the host access to the NVIDIA GPU through WSL2's passthrough, or establish that containers do not need the GPU on this host.
slots.a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: A rootless container running nvidia-smi and one inference workload on the target WSL release, with setup steps and failure modes recorded.

slots.title: Web search for research harnesses
slots.requirement: Give the research harnesses a web search provider that needs no paid service and returns usable results for technical queries.
slots.a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Recall of known-relevant pages for a fixed set of technical queries, rate limiting under ten parallel queries, and setup effort.

slots.title: Structural code search and rewrite
slots.requirement: Search and rewrite code by syntax-tree pattern from the command line, or establish that symbol navigation and text search already cover the need.
slots.a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Precision and recall on a fixed set of structural queries against text search and symbol tools, and the tokens an agent spends per answered query.

slots.title: Messaging between agent sessions
slots.requirement: Let concurrent agent sessions of both coding agents on one host exchange messages and hand work to each other, or establish that the clients' native facilities cover it.
slots.a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Delivery and ordering of messages between a Claude Code session and a Codex session, behaviour when the receiver is busy or gone, and setup effort.

slots.title: Secret scanning
slots.requirement: Stop credentials from entering commits and find leaked ones in history, with one scanner unless a second one adds a distinct, needed job.
slots.a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Detection and false positives on a seeded corpus, pre-commit latency, and what a second scanner finds that the first misses.

slots.title: Agent and LLM trace store
slots.requirement: Store and inspect traces of agent and LLM calls locally from OpenTelemetry data, with one tool unless a second adds a distinct, needed job.
slots.a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Ingestion of both agents' OpenTelemetry output, query and inspection of a fixed set of traces, resource use, and overlap with experiment tracking.
